wiz.cur: Currency In which currency is the price? Toman (IRT) suits card and Zarinpal payments, USDT suits crypto.
wiz.price: Price in {currency} What the customer pays. Toman is a whole number; USDT may have decimals (up to 6). 0 makes it free. Example: 150000 (Toman) or 2.5 (USDT).
wiz.days: Duration in days How long the service lasts after it is bought. 0 means no time limit (then a traffic limit is needed). Example: 30
wiz.gb: Traffic in GB How much traffic the service has. 0 means unlimited (then a duration is needed). Example: 100
wiz.plan.name_en: New plan: the English name What customers who use English see on the plan button and the invoice. Example: Gold 30 days Up to 80 characters. Send - to skip it (then the Persian name is required).
wiz.plan.name_fa: New plan: the Persian name What customers who use Persian see on the plan button and the invoice. Example: طلایی ۳۰ روزه Up to 80 characters. Send - to skip it (then the English name is used for everyone).
wiz.topup.name_en: New traffic package: the English name Shown on the button where a customer adds traffic. Example: +50 GB Up to 80 characters. Send - to skip it (then the Persian name is required).
wiz.topup.name_fa: New traffic package: the Persian name Shown on the button where a customer adds traffic. Example: ۵۰ گیگ اضافه Up to 80 characters. Send - to skip it.
wiz.topup.gb: Traffic of the package, in GB How much extra traffic the customer gets. Example: 50
wiz.pe.name_en: The English name What customers who use English see. Up to 80 characters. Send - to remove it (the Persian name stays).
wiz.pe.name_fa: The Persian name What customers who use Persian see. Up to 80 characters. Send - to remove it (the English name stays).
wiz.pe.price: The price in {currency} What the customer pays. Toman is a whole number; USDT may have decimals (up to 6). 0 makes it free. Example: 150000 (Toman) or 2.5 (USDT).
wiz.pe.days: Duration in days How long the service lasts. 0 means no time limit. Example: 30
wiz.pe.gb: Traffic in GB How much traffic the service has. 0 means unlimited. Example: 100
wiz.trial.days: Free trial: days How long a trial lasts. 0 means no time limit (then a traffic limit is needed). Example: 3
wiz.trial.gb: Free trial: traffic in GB How much traffic a trial has. 0 means unlimited (then days are needed). Example: 1
wiz.disc.code: The discount code What customers type to get the discount. 3 to 32 characters: letters A to Z, digits, _ or -. Small letters become capitals. Example: SPRING20
wiz.disc.kind: Kind of discount A percentage takes a share off the price. A fixed amount takes off a set sum in one currency.
wiz.disc.percent: Percent off How many percent the customer saves. Example: 20
wiz.disc.amount: Amount off, in {currency} The sum taken off the price. Example: 50000 (Toman) or 1.5 (USDT).
wiz.disc.max: How many times it can be used In all, by every customer together. 0 means no limit. Example: 100
wiz.disc.days: How many days it is valid Counted from now. 0 means it never expires. Example: 7
wiz.sw.weight: Server weight A server with a higher weight gets more of the new services. Services it already has do not move. Example: 10
wiz.staff.tg: Telegram id of the person A number, not a @username. They must have started the bot once; their id is on their user card (Find user). Example: 123456789
wiz.staff.role: Role Support answers tickets in the dashboard. Admin also sells and manages plans, payments and broadcasts. Owner can do everything, staff and servers included.
wiz.staff.reason: Reason Why you give this role. It is kept in the audit log. Up to 500 characters. Example: new support agent
wiz.staff.rem_reason: Reason Why you remove this person. It is kept in the audit log. Up to 500 characters. Example: left the team
wiz.bc.segment: Who gets the broadcast? All customers; only those with a live subscription; those whose subscription expired; or those who never bought.
wiz.bc.text_fa: The message in Persian Sent to customers whose language is Persian. Both a Persian and an English text are required. Telegram's HTML tags work: <b>bold</b>, <i>, <u>, <s>, <code>. Formatting you apply inside Telegram is not kept.
wiz.bc.text_en: The message in English Sent to customers whose language is English. Telegram's HTML tags work: <b>bold</b>, <i>, <u>, <s>, <code>. Formatting you apply inside Telegram is not kept.

setting.general.timezone.help: The bot shows dates (such as when a service ends) in this time zone. “Server default” is BOBRES_TIMEZONE, else Tehran. Dates in this dashboard follow your own device’s clock.
setting.general.bot_profile.label: Keep the bot’s Telegram profile up to date
setting.general.bot_profile.help: The bot sets its menu commands, its description (the text of an empty chat) and its short description (its profile page), in Persian and English, from its texts: edit them under Branding & texts → Bot texts → Bot profile. It also sets its profile photo from Branding & texts → Store → Telegram bot. Turned off, it takes back its Persian and English texts and the staff menus, so what you set in @BotFather shows; the photo stays. The bot’s name is always set in @BotFather.
setting.branding.sub_page.enabled.label: Subscription page
setting.branding.sub_page.enabled.help: Every service gets its own page at /sub/<secret> with its link, QR code and app guides. Turned off, those addresses answer “not found” and the bot and dashboard stop showing them.
setting.branding.bot_username.label: Bot username
setting.branding.bot_username.help: The bot’s @username (without the @), for the “Renew” button on the subscription page, which opens the bot. Empty: the page has no renew button.
setting.miniapp.enabled.label: Telegram Mini App store
setting.miniapp.enabled.help: Opens the store as a Mini App inside Telegram at /app/: plans, buying with the wallet or a payment gateway, services, renewing, wallet top-up, the free trial, invites and support. On by default: the bot opens it from a Store button and Telegram's menu button, which need the store's public HTTPS address, so there is nothing to set in @BotFather. Turned off, /app/ and its API answer “not found” and the buttons go.
setting.maintenance.enabled.label: Maintenance mode
setting.maintenance.enabled.help: While on, customers only see the maintenance message. Staff can still use the bot and payments in progress finish. Change the message under Branding & texts.
setting.join.channel.label: Channel
setting.join.channel.help: A public channel’s @name, or a private channel’s numeric id. Empty turns the requirement off. Staff are never checked, and customers are let in if Telegram does not answer.
setting.join.link.label: Join link
setting.join.link.help: The bot’s “Join” button opens this link. A public channel can leave it empty; a private channel needs an invite link.
setting.notify.new_payment.label: New payment to review
setting.notify.new_payment.help: When a customer sends a card receipt, a USDT transaction or a Zarinpal reference, with a button to review it.
setting.notify.new_ticket.label: New support ticket
setting.notify.new_ticket.help: When a customer writes to support in the bot.
setting.notify.provision_failed.label: Service could not be created
setting.notify.provision_failed.help: When a paid service could not be created on the 3x-ui panel and needs a look.
setting.notify.system_alerts.label: System problems
setting.notify.system_alerts.help: When a service, a 3x-ui server, Zarinpal, the backups, the disk, paid orders, the bot's messages or another part of the system has a problem, once a day while it lasts, and when it is fixed. Open problems always show on the System page.
setting.notify.sales.label: Every sale
setting.notify.sales.help: A message for every paid order, with the customer, plan and amount.
setting.notify.recipients.label: Recipients
setting.notify.recipients.help: “Only the store owner” is the Telegram account set as owner when BOBRES was installed. “Every owner and admin” is every active owner and admin; support staff get only the ticket alerts, never payment or sales ones.
setting.support.autoclose_days.label: Close answered tickets after (days)
setting.support.autoclose_days.help: A ticket whose customer has not written back this many days after a staff reply is closed, without a message. 0 turns this off.
setting.limits.bot_per_10s.label: Messages per user in 10 seconds
setting.limits.bot_per_10s.help: Someone who sends more messages or taps more buttons than this gets no answer until those 10 seconds are over. Stops spam and load on the server.
setting.limits.tickets_per_day.label: Tickets per customer per day
setting.limits.tickets_per_day.help: A customer cannot send more support tickets than this in 24 hours. 0 means no limit.
setting.limits.broadcast_per_sec.label: Broadcast messages per second
setting.limits.broadcast_per_sec.help: How fast broadcasts go out (1 to 25). Telegram allows about 30 messages a second for the whole bot; the bot's replies to customers go first and slow a broadcast down when it is busy.
setting.payments.manual_card.enabled.hel: When off, customers do not see card to card, even with a card number set.
setting.payments.card_number.label: Card number or sheba
setting.payments.card_number.help: Shown to customers for card-to-card payments: a 16-digit card number, or a sheba (IR and 24 digits). Empty turns card payments off.
setting.payments.card_holder.label: Card holder
setting.payments.card_holder.help: Shown next to the card number so customers know they pay the right person.
setting.payments.manual_crypto.enabled.h: When off, customers do not see USDT, even with an address set.
setting.payments.usdt_trc20.label: USDT address (TRC20)
setting.payments.usdt_trc20.help: Your Tron wallet address for USDT payments; it starts with T. Empty means this network is not offered.
setting.payments.usdt_erc20.label: USDT address (ERC20)
setting.payments.usdt_erc20.help: Your Ethereum wallet address for USDT payments; it starts with 0x. Empty means this network is not offered.
setting.payments.usdt_rate.label: Toman per USDT
setting.payments.usdt_rate.help: At this rate, Toman-priced plans can also be paid in USDT. Empty means USDT only for plans priced in USDT.
setting.payments.stars.enabled.label: Offer Telegram Stars
setting.payments.stars.enabled.help: When off, customers do not see Stars, even with a rate set.
setting.payments.stars_rate.label: Toman per Telegram Star
setting.payments.stars_rate.help: For payments in Telegram Stars; amounts are rounded up to whole Stars. Empty means Stars are not offered.
setting.payments.manual_zarinpal.enabled: When off, customers do not see the link, even when it is set.
setting.payments.zarinpal_link.label: Zarinpal link
setting.payments.zarinpal_link.help: Your own Zarinpal payment link (https). Customers pay there and send the reference for you to review.
admin.err_user_unknown: ⚠️ No customer has this id: the person must open the bot and tap Start first.
report.daily_vs_about_same: about the same as the day before
report.daily_vs_up_lots: up more than {pct} on the day before
report.daily_vs_new: new: no sales the day before
report.daily_zone: Days are read in the time zone {zone}.
